resumeText:
Rohit Kulkarni | Pune | rohit.kulkarni@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Powertrain Integration Engineer, Sahyadri Electric Mobility, Pune (2022 - present)
- Integrated the traction motor, inverter and battery pack on an electric 3-wheeler cargo platform.
- Owned EV powertrain integration of the e-axle and signed off 40 vehicle-level tests for the launch.
- Ran motor dyno and chassis dyno tests for torque, efficiency and thermal derating.
- Checked PMSM torque-speed curves and efficiency maps against supplier data.
- Worked with the traction inverter supplier on SiC MOSFET derating and gate driver faults.
- Decoded CAN traffic in Vector CANalyzer to debug inverter and VCU fault codes.
- Built range simulation models in MATLAB/Simulink for the MIDC drive cycle.

Test Engineer, Deccan Auto Components, Pune (2020 - 2022)
- Ran durability tests on gearbox sub-assemblies and wrote test reports.
- Led DFMEA reviews for gearbox mounting brackets with the design team.

EDUCATION
BE Mechanical Engineering, College of Engineering Pune, 2020

SKILLS
MATLAB, Simulink, CANalyzer, ETAS INCA, DFMEA
